The evidence is fragmented by domain: macroeconomics shows real adaptation, disaster reconstruction shows mixed follow-through, and political-control episodes show much weaker correction and more coercion.","evidence":[{"title":"Turkey's Erdogan says party to self-critique after local election losses","publisher":"The Straits Times / Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/turkeys-erdogan-says-party-to-self-critique-after-local-election-losses","summary":"After the local-election defeat, Erdoğan publicly said the alliance had missed its target and would do self-criticism and address shortcomings. That is direct evidence of tactical acknowledgement and some willingness to adjust.","question_ids":["8B.8","8B.7"]},{"title":"Turkey's Erdogan signs off on Sweden's NATO membership ratification","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-25","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-signs-off-on-swedens-nato-membership-ratification-3283398","summary":"After a long delay, Erdoğan ratified Sweden’s NATO accession, ending a stalled dispute. This shows he could drop obstruction once it stopped serving the broader bargaining line.","question_ids":["8B.8","8B.7"]},{"title":"Turkey central bank chief quits, citing need to protect her family","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-02-02","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/turkey-central-bank-chief-resigns-after-aggressive-rate-hikes-3291652","summary":"When the governor resigned, Erdoğan immediately replaced her with Fatih Karahan, a technocrat expected to continue tight policy. This looks like a badly corrected recovery policy that generated new harm.","question_ids":["8B.8","8B.7"]}]}
